source.title: Cooperating grammar systems. (Definitions, basic results, open problems)

trace.notes: Normalized the URL as a zbMATH resolver URL for document id 878942. Direct CLI fetch of https://zbmath.org/878942 returned HTTP 403 with a Cloudflare challenge, classified as blocked_or_challenged.

Queried the zbMATH Open API endpoint https://api.zbmath.org/v1/document/878942. The resolver metadata identifies the exact work as Jürgen Dassow, Cooperating grammar systems. (Definitions, basic results, open problems), in Artificial Life: Grammatical Models, Black Sea University Press, 1995, pages 40-52. The API record exposed no readable full-text links, so metadata was used only for identity and title recovery.

Bounded exact-work recovery attempted queries for the exact title plus PDF, the title plus Dassow and open problems, and the edited-volume title or ISBN. Inspected candidates included the Otto von Guericke University bibliography pages and a used-book listing for Artificial Life: Grammatical Models; these were metadata-only or sale/listing pages and did not contain the chapter text or a PDF. No readable exact-work PDF or HTML full-text source was recovered.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/878942.json and outputs/latest.json.
